g.text: duallity_wfst_new — capture once, build lazily, compose after the source is gone
duallity_wfst_new(dictionary, query, k, algorithm, kind, out)
CAPTURE ONCE — the only snapshot call.
The revision is immutable and independently retained.
source dictionary may now be mutated or dropped
The captured revision backs every later expansion,
so results are stable even after the source is gone.
